sinopsis.es: Un guerrillero descubre una pequeña araña refugiada en el cañón de su fusil. Al día siguiente, cuando va a limpiar el arma, encuentra una fina red que crea un efecto caleidoscópico al ser atravesada por la luz. Fascinado por la belleza del universo tejido por la araña, experimenta un nuevo impulso: preservar la vida.
sinopsis.en: A guerrilla combatant discovers a tiny spider that takes refuge inside the barrel of his rifle. The next day, as he prepares to clean his weapon, he notices a fine web that creates a kaleidoscopic effect when light passes through it. Fascinated by the beauty of the universe woven by the spider inside his rifle, the combatant experiences a new impulse: to preserve life.
